text.card: A red giant 7,148 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.13 solar masses and 19.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,753 K at its surface.
